evidence.title: Apify: Marketplace of ready-to-run tools for AI

name: Apify
summary: Marketplace of 84,000+ ready-to-run cloud tools (Actors) for web scraping, data extraction and AI agents.
description: Apify Store is a marketplace of serverless cloud programs called Actors that take JSON input and return structured output: website scrapers, lead generation, social media monitoring, competitor tracking and content feeds for RAG pipelines. Actors run from a console, REST API, CLI, SDK or MCP server, and independent creators publish and price their own Actors and get monthly payouts.
contains: free plan renews $5 of usage credit monthly, no credit card
paid plans from $19/month plus pay-as-you-go usage, 10% off when billed annually
MCP server, REST API, CLI, SDK (apify-client) and agent quickstart
JavaScript, TypeScript and Python code templates; $500 free usage for new creators
marketplace: third-party creators publish Actors and earn monthly payouts
